transcript.text: Thanks for joining this planning huddle. As we discussed, the operations team and employee-support team have been running separate weekly forums on the same afternoon, and we've heard clear complaints from employees that the agendas overlap. I have the authority to replace both forums with a single recurring format and set its operating rules, but before I make anything binding, I want to understand the practical constraints. So I'm asking both of you -- the forum coordinator and the employee representative -- to walk me through what we need to account for: scheduling, format preferences, follow-up processes, anything that would make or break a combined forum. What are you seeing on your end?

commitments.detail: The combined forum will start no earlier than 11:00 to accommodate remote employees with caregiving responsibilities.
A 30-minute confidential escalation segment will be preserved within the combined forum, accessible only to authorized participants.
A written confidentiality protocol will be included in the forum's operating rules governing the confidential segment.
Live video participation will be supported for all attendees, including remote employees.
A recorded summary will be provided whenever an individual cannot attend the forum.
